span.p:
Splits on ANY Whitespace
RIGHT to LEFT
'Hello World' → ['Hello', 'World']

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Separator Found
'a,b,c'.rsplit(',') → ['a', 'b', 'c']
Same as split() when no maxsplit

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Separator Not Found
'apple'.rsplit(',') → ['apple']
Same as split()

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
With maxsplit=1
Starts from RIGHT
'a,b,c'.rsplit(',', 1) → ['a,b', 'c']
Different from split(): ['a', 'b,c']
